name: Grand Hotel Majestic gia Baglioni
insider_take: This palatial 1445 palazzo sits on Bologna's main artery, where Renaissance grandeur meets modern luxury in Italy's culinary capital.
whats_special: The hotel occupies a historic 15th-century palace right on Via dell'Indipendenza, Bologna's premier shopping street. Its frescoed ballroom has hosted royalty and dignitaries for centuries, while the rooftop terrace offers stunning views of the city's famous Two Towers and terracotta rooftops.
pro_tip: Book the Carracci Restaurant for dinner – it's one of only two Michelin-starred restaurants in Bologna, and hotel guests get priority reservations for this coveted culinary experience.
dont_miss: Take a 5-minute walk to Piazza Maggiore to see the unfinished Basilica of San Petronio (larger than many cathedrals) and climb the 498 steps of Torre degli Asinelli for panoramic views. The hotel is also perfectly positioned to explore Bologna's 25 miles of medieval porticoes – a UNESCO World Heritage site.
pros: Landmark 18th-century palazzo with stunning frescoed ceilings, original artwork, and opulent historic interiors that make every stay feel like a museum experience
Prime location in the heart of Bologna on Via dell'Indipendenza, steps from the iconic Piazza Maggiore and the city's celebrated culinary and cultural scene
Exceptionally personalized service befitting its Leading Hotels of the World membership, with attentive staff dedicated to anticipating every guest need
Award-winning I Carracci Restaurant, celebrated for showcasing the finest Emilian cuisine in an elegantly frescoed dining room
Lavishly appointed rooms and suites blending classic Italian grandeur with modern luxury amenities, offering a truly refined and comfortable retreat
cons: Urban city-center setting means limited on-site outdoor leisure spaces such as a pool or expansive gardens
Premium heritage property with rates reflective of its five-star historic grandeur, best suited for luxury-focused travelers
